purpose: Current-branch overrides after 2026-08-24 rollback/re-audit. v003 rules remain active unless explicitly superseded here.

overrides.effective_rule: The old Sep-1943 US Midway recapture operation does not occur. Its sortie gate used an incorrect three-carrier Japanese core. Recalculate all dependent losses, availability and operational dates.
overrides.reason: Correct Japanese fleet-carrier core in Sep 1943 is Shokaku, Zuikaku, Hiryu and Soryu.

overrides.effective_rule: Soryu survives the branch Midway and remains in the fleet-carrier core unless a later re-adjudicated event removes her. After Taiho completion the physical carrier hull total is 11: four established fleet carriers + Taiho + six second-line carriers.
overrides.reason: Old 1944 tables remembered second-line carriers but silently omitted Soryu.

overrides.effective_rule: GALVANIC is delayed to Feb 1944 (working D-Day around Feb 9; exact tide/H-hour remains open). Recalculate Tarawa/Makin, carrier damage, base-building and Marshall follow-on dates from this delay.

After Kwajalein loss, Combined Fleet does not reconcentrate at Truk. High-value mobile assets disperse west; Truk becomes a local air/submarine/recon/communications node and is accepted as a fixed-base attrition target.

Five-Go Phase III-A is a limited Hanzhong-to-Guangyuan operation and is GO; deep ground pursuit to Chengdu is NO-GO by default. The strategic payoff is airfield/logistics geography, not Sichuan conquest.

Retain the old Burma main line: no deep U-Go/Imphal-Kohima offensive. Raise North Burma/Myitkyina importance; keep NCAC pressure historical-to-slightly-strong while Y-Force is somewhat delayed/reduced by China-proper pressure.

For current continuation, use 1944-04-11 post-HAILSTONE-equivalent as the analysis frontier. Later v012 Saipan/July and China-August adjudications are reference/provisional only until re-run from the corrected spring branch.

edit_protocol: Do not delete v003 or later historical/provisional settlements. Current continuation follows v004 plus the 2026-08-24 session settlement.
